_TEMPLATE: Copy to .cbsp21/patches/<dep>-<version>-bump.json and fill every <ANGLE> field. It lives OUTSIDE .cbsp21/patches/ on purpose: discovery globs patches/*.json with no template exclusion, so a template kept there would be a live candidate. Copy it INTO patches/ under a real name. Delete this _TEMPLATE key in your copy.
_WHY_THIS_EXISTS: Dependabot cannot author a manifest, so a human authors one per bump. That is the intended friction: before CBSP21-NOBORROW-001, dependency PRs passed by borrowing a manifest written for a different change, and PR #296 -- a supabase bump that also silently reverted zod 4 to 3 -- passed that way. The undeclared change is exactly what behavior_change exists to surface. Filling this in takes a minute and is the whole point.
title: build(deps): bump <dependency> from <old> to <new>
intent: <Why this bump. A security advisory, a required peer range, a transitive fix, or routine currency. If it is routine, say so -- 'routine currency, no advisory' is a real answer and better than an invented rationale.>
behavior_change: <READ THE LOCKFILE DIFF BEFORE WRITING THIS. State every package whose version changed, not only the one in the title. A bump that also moves or reverts an unrelated dependency is the defect this field exists to catch, and it will not announce itself -- diff against the merge base, not the PR view.>

diff_articulation.what_changed: <The direct bump, plus every incidental version movement in the lockfile.>
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: <Why now. If it is Dependabot currency, that is sufficient -- say it plainly.>

commands_run: <lockfile audit: list every package whose version changed, e.g. `git diff <merge-base> -- packages/client/package-lock.json | grep '"version"'`>
<build/test evidence, or an explicit statement that CI is the only verification>

architecture_scan.acknowledgement_notes: <Dependency bump; no architectural surface. If the lockfile moved anything beyond the titled package, say so here as well as in behavior_change.>
